correctness.rationale: The bilateral XOR differences d_i=x_i⊕x_(i+1) are unrestricted, and the first-step output is d_(i−1)∨d_i. This output has no isolated one; conversely any word on the bilateral shift avoiding 010 is recovered by taking differences d_i=y_i∧y_(i+1). For the second image, the independent reconstruction used an eight-vertex de Bruijn graph on three difference bits instead of the supplied 16-vertex graph on original bits. Label the edge for four bits a,b,c,d by whether a∨b,b∨c,c∨d are not all equal. All difference blocks integrate and extend to bilateral inputs. Determinizing from all vertices and refining right languages gave 17 live subsets and 13 accepting minimized states. For the forbidden computation, accept precisely a dead final prefix-state transition with a live suffix-state transition; all proper contiguous factors are contained in the prefix or suffix missing one letter. Both individual letters occur. The count is of distinct words because the machines are deterministic and each productive path specifies its letters. The independent pair graph had 29 reachable and 16 productive states. Exact transfer arithmetic reproduced the characteristic polynomials, coefficients through degree 17 of det(I−zA)M(z), and the displayed list through length 25. The degree bound 2+15 proves the all-length identity. There is one 14-state primitive component with self-loops on productive paths; the other two states are transient, giving m_2(n)∼Cλ^n with C>0 and hence a strictly sofic image. The image automaton's Perron growth governs all admitted words since all accepting states are accessible. Independent exact shifted-power coefficient signs isolate both largest real roots in the stated disjoint rational intervals. Wu–Zhang Theorem A applies since the minimal forbidden words generate the shift, so h_G≤h_M<h_top; this gives the stated finite ergodic, Bernoulli-up-to-period and characteristic maximal-entropy-measure conclusions without asserting how many such ergodic measures there are.
correctness.replay: Shift and append 0 or 1 on the eight three-bit states, using the four-difference-bit edge label in the rationale; perform subset closure and right-language refinement, then form the prefix/suffix pairs and trim backward from terminal letters. In one numbering the image states (start 0, −1 dead) have (0,1)-rows (1,0),(1,2),(−1,3),(1,4),(5,0),(5,6),(−1,7),(8,9),(8,10),(5,11),(−1,5),(5,12),(8,3). For the productive adjacency A, after omission of dead and terminal transitions the destination lists are [1],[2],[3],[4],[4,5],[6],[7,8],[7,9],[10],[11],[4,12],[4,13],[7,2],[14],[7,15],[4,10]. The productive initial state is 0, with terminal counts one at states 1 and 13 and zero elsewhere. Newton identities for the two adjacency matrices and multiplication of z²u(I−zA)^−1e by det(I−zA) reproduce the polynomials. At the lower rational endpoint of each bracket, expand its corresponding degree-8 or degree-13 polynomial as P(L+x): the constant coefficient is negative and all other coefficients positive. At each upper endpoint, all coefficients of P(U+x) are positive. Integer arithmetic after clearing 10^6 powers proves the signs, hence a root between and no root above the upper endpoint.

value.rationale: Rule 126 is a natural benchmark with an unusually simple first image and a known sharp finite discrepancy. The all-length second-image obstruction series demonstrates a change to strictly sofic behavior with exponentially many minimal forbidden words after just one further update. Its rate is provably separated from the language entropy; this is an evaluated nontrivial test case for the entropy-gap theorem, beyond an arbitrary finite enumeration or the previously known shortest witness.
residual_risks: Specific to one rule and one time; no claim of a taxonomy of later images or explicit classification of the maximizing measures.
